items.title: 52222_Marshall Royal oral history interview
items.q: He also had as his clientele Marco Hellman... So, when we got there and Marco Hellman saw my mother, he says, 'My God, Royal,' he says, 'what is she doing here?'

ctx.x: would come to school with a bean sandwich, he was pretty poor. Although my dad always provided a little bit better because he was fortunate enough to be able to demand a pretty good salary for his one-nighters and things he did. He didn't work these regular dance halls and things in those days. He worked special jobs for the people that were the 'get-rich-quick' Hollywood crowd in the movie industry that was just coming up at that time. He worked parties for Gloria Swanson and the producers like James Cruse…

At the time when they were subdividing and putting this new area over here right outside of Pasadena called Flint-ridge and La Crescenta, when they were subdividing, we -- my dad played for subdivisions of all of that. He used to play for the clambakes down at what is now Palos Verdes off the beach, when they were subdividing that, when it was nothing but ground. He played for the subdivisions of those things and he was able to name his own price for jobs and so in doing so, he also had as his clientele Marco…
